critical_code_review_comments: commit_ingestion_records raises HTTPException 400 mid-loop after some records may already have been inserted (e.g. contacts). Not a functional bug for the tested flow (invoices processed before payments/tasks and the caller wraps in try/finally at DB level? — actually no rollback). If a doc has contacts + one invoice, the contact insert has already committed before the 400 fires. Consider validating all invoices up-front before any insert.
